name: Earth Surface & Weather Imaging
description: Capture multispectral imagery of Earth's cloud formations, vegetation health, and coastal erosion patterns.
baseline_science: Deliver 100 high-resolution multispectral image sets per week at under 100 m ground sample distance.
threshold_science: Deliver at least 20 cloud-free regional image sets per week at 250 m ground sample distance.
explanation: High-value Earth imaging mission requiring consistent solar lighting and high-throughput data downlinks.

name: Solar Flare & Space Weather Monitor
description: Measure solar X-ray flux, coronal mass ejection particle streams, and ionospheric ionization levels.
baseline_science: Record continuous solar X-ray irradiance across five major solar flare eruption events.
threshold_science: Detect solar energetic particle background flux for 30 consecutive days.
explanation: Heliophysics mission mapping radiation hazards in the space environment to protect terrestrial infrastructure.

name: Autonomous Deep Space Beacon & Trajectory Demo
description: Demonstrate miniature optical navigation, micro-propulsion orbital maneuvers, and long-range communications beyond LEO.
baseline_science: Execute autonomous trajectory estimation and maintain bidirectional beacon telemetry for 60 days.
threshold_science: Successfully transmit telemetry beacon packets from a high-energy transfer orbit back to ground stations.
explanation: Technology maturation mission testing deep space navigation and communications beyond the protection of Earth's magnetosphere.
